project.name: OTTL Java :: Standard Functions
project.description: Standard OTTL editors (set, delete_key, keep_keys, replace_match, replace_all_matches, replace_pattern, replace_all_patterns) and converters (Concat, ConvertCase, Double, Int, IsBool, IsDouble, IsList, IsMap, IsMatch, IsString, Len, Split, String, Substring, Trim, TrimPrefix, TrimSuffix). Registered via ServiceLoader so the plain engine discovers them. The Quarkus recorder registers the same classes explicitly.
